findings.issue: Cost calculation double-division bug in chat_study
findings.description: Line 2273 passes `input_size_chars // 4` to calculate_ai_cost_neurons, but the function internally divides by 4 again for chat operations. This results in costs 4× too low (example: 4000 char prompt yields 0.5 neurons instead of 2.0). This underestimates billing by 4× and will cause auditing discrepancies.
findings.fix: Pass `input_size_chars` directly instead of pre-dividing by 4, or update calculate_ai_cost_neurons to accept tokens instead of characters for chat operations.

findings.issue: Incomplete use of unified cost function
findings.description: Specification claims calculate_ai_cost_neurons is called in all three call_cf_* functions, but call_cf_vision returns hardcoded NEURONS_PER_IMAGE (150) and call_cf_tts returns inline calculation (len(text) / 10.0), neither using the unified function. Only call_cf_chat uses it (with a 4× multiplication workaround). This breaks the single-source-of-truth pattern and makes future cost adjustments error-prone.
findings.fix: Update call_cf_vision and call_cf_tts to use calculate_ai_cost_neurons; fix the API design flaw so the same call pattern works across all three functions.

findings.description: synthesize_study_audio in tts_hybrid.py calls call_cf_tts but does not log cost to AiUsageLog. Vision and chat costs are audited; TTS operations have no billing trail. This creates an asymmetry in cost tracking.
findings.fix: Log TTS cost to AiUsageLog at call sites that use synthesize_study_audio (e.g., asset generation endpoints).
